_note: How ArchGen installs, wires and exposes CodeGraph. One source of truth; override per machine with ARCHGEN_CODEGRAPH_*.

_fields.install: What to install when the CLI is MISSING. 'latest' = the newest published release. An EXISTING install is never touched — it is the user's to manage.
_fields.wire: The exact spec the MCP entry's npx fallback uses. Pinned so a machine with no binary still resolves a reviewed version.
_fields.tools: The CodeGraph MCP tools the agent may call (CODEGRAPH_MCP_TOOLS). The allowlist REPLACES CodeGraph's default, so every tool wanted is named.
_fields.telemetry: 'off' sets CODEGRAPH_TELEMETRY=0 in the MCP entry — per process, no machine-wide write.
